description: Statutory 5/10/15 days. The year someone first qualifies, or joins the employer with 12 months already worked, counts only the calendar days left from that day (a rehire from the rejoining date), less school vacation days (`school_vacation_days`). One `annual_leave_year_reviews` row a year records the decision: `disqualified` and `next_year_disqualified` remove the grant, `waived_days` are spent without pay, and `deferred_days` move across one year only. ANNUAL_LEAVE_FORFEITED refuses leave once personal or sick leave passes the statute's limits. On exit an encashment entry pays the days earned so far at the extra 200% (第十条: 300% including the normal wage already paid); the day is the current day rate.
